localSource.implementationCommitSubject: feat(import): complete conflict resolution R3a contract

routeFamily.uniqueProductionRenderer: eight inline import screen functions dispatched by renderRoute
routeFamily.dispatchPolicy: All eight primary routes remain owned by the existing render-runtime inline canonical functions and are post-render instrumented by ReaderImportRuntimeContract.
routeFamily.singleOwnerEvidence: index.html and the deterministic inventory VM do not load w1-import-renderers.js; no W1 dispatch path was enabled, so there is no double owner.

r2aInstrumentation.identityPolicy: Only the stable batch, item, conflict and named action keys participate in identity. Labels, selectors, DOM order, ordinal n0-style keys and screenshots are prohibited.
r2aInstrumentation.runtimeEvidence: The deterministic production VM rendered all eight primary routes and found 32/32 controls carrying all five canonical identity attributes.
r2aInstrumentation.generatedRegistryIsolation: Logical registry differences from the baseline are limited to the eight declared primary routes.

guards: resolve, commit and retry reject a second activation while pending.status is loading
completion requires the current requestId, requestEpoch and an open owner
close increments requestEpoch and cancels an in-flight operation so later completion resolves stale
repeated close is idempotently reported as closed
item selection accepts only the three stable item IDs
conflict selection accepts only title, author or group and keep-local, overwrite or keep-both

ariaAndFocus.accessibleNames: All 32 controls have explicit aria-label values after production instrumentation.
ariaAndFocus.focusReturn: Every non-back action carries an exact data-restore-focus control key; owner close preserves the initiating focus key.
ariaAndFocus.parsing: The parsing detail is role=status with aria-live=polite and aria-busy=true; progressbar values are bounded from 0 to 100.
ariaAndFocus.permissionRecovery: System settings, retry and exit preserve distinct UiEvent semantics.
ariaAndFocus.nativeSemantics: Existing data-route and data-action attributes survive identity stamping.

figmaReadOnlyBaseline.structuralPolicy: The serial writer must identify the real canonical import components and downstream instances from a fresh revision, repair canonical components first, and preserve existing reactions. Unknown node IDs are intentionally not guessed.

figmaDecisionsRequired: Read a fresh official Figma revision and resolve the real import component set, Phone master, Tablet master and downstream instances before writing.
Update shared progress, duplicate item, conflict row, result row and state/action components before page masters.
Preserve stable batch, item and conflict identity and keep trailing metadata/actions right-aligned.
Model parsing, duplicate, conflict, partial-success, permission and error states within this canonical family.
Use only Phone and Tablet; Landscape inherits Tablet and Compact/Fold structures are prohibited.
Preserve reactions. Figma may not change UiEvent, state owner, async guards, route ownership or import business flow.
Detached frames and screenshot replacements are prohibited.
